excerpt.zh: 我们试图俘获[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的行动失败了。非常的不幸，我们在动手之前跟丢了它们的舰船。
excerpt.en: Our efforts to capture the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have ended in failure. Unfortunately, we lost track of their ship before we could attempt to seize it.

texts.zh: 我们试图俘获[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的行动失败了。非常的不幸，我们在动手之前跟丢了它们的舰船。
texts.en: Our efforts to capture the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have ended in failure. Unfortunately, we lost track of their ship before we could attempt to seize it.

texts.zh: 我们试图俘获[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的行动失败了。非常的不幸，它们成功地躲避了我们的俘虏行动，并在我们将舰船无力化之前就逃脱了恒星系。我们的未来乌云密布——不仅是因为要找出它们的信息更加困难艰巨了，也是因为它们一定会将这次行动当作我们敌视它们的一部分。
texts.en: Our efforts to capture the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have ended in failure. Unfortunately, they managed to elude our capture attempt and escape the system before we could disable their ship. This bodes ill for the future - not only do we face an uphill struggle to find out more about them, but they will surely consider this to be a hostile act on our part.

label.zh: 我们现在必须加把劲翻译它们的语言了。
label.en: We must redouble our efforts to translate their language.

texts.zh: [ship_to_seize.GetName]，我们派去调查[From.Owner.GetName]的飞船，勉强躲过了对方武装力量的恶意攻击。他们似乎想要截获我们的船只并审讯船员，很有还带着对我们开展进一步攻击行动为自己牟利的目的。不过谢天谢地，在一切失去控制之前，[ship_to_seize.GetName]设法发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
texts.en: The [ship_to_seize.GetName], our vessel we had sent to investigate the [From.Owner.GetName], narrowly escaped a vicious attack by their forces. It seems they had thought to seize our ship to interrogate our crew, probably with the aim of swinging further hostilities against us in their favor. Thankfully, the [ship_to_seize.GetName] managed to engage emergency FTL before it was too late.

texts.zh: [ship_to_seize.GetName]，我们派去调查[From.Owner.GetName]的飞船，勉强躲过了对方武装力量的恶意攻击。他们似乎是想截获我们的船只并逆向科技，很有可能想着对我们展开进一步攻击为自己牟利。不过谢天谢地，在一切失去控制前，[ship_to_seize.GetName]设法发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
texts.en: The [ship_to_seize.GetName], our vessel we had sent to investigate the [From.Owner.GetName], narrowly escaped a vicious attack by their forces. It seems they had thought to seize our ship and steal our technologies, probably with the aim of swinging further hostilities against us in their favor. Thankfully, the [ship_to_seize.GetName] managed to engage emergency FTL before it was too late.
